body:
1. make daily summary disabled by default 
2. increase default orchestrate run from 5 to 12

comments.body:
This is supported and looks like a small defaults-only change.

Current places to change:

- Daily summary scheduling is gated by `AGENT_SCHEDULE_POLICY`. The unset default is `skip_no_updates` in [`schedule-policy.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/schedule-policy.ts#L15-L18), and [`agent-daily-summary.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-daily-summary.yml#L44-L50) consumes that policy. Best implementation: add a default workflow override for `agent-daily-summary.yml: disabled`, so cron is off by default while manual `workflow_dispatch` still works.
- Orchestrate rounds default to `5` in workflow inputs/fallbacks, for example [`agent-router.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L67-L70), [`agent-entrypoint.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-entrypoint.yml#L56-L57), and [`agent-orchestrator.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-orchestrator.yml#L69-L72). There are also TypeScript fallback defaults in [`orchestrate-handoff.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/cli/orchestrate-handoff.ts#L870), [`orchestrator-preflight.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/cli/orchestrator-preflight.ts#L24-L26), [`dispatch-agent-implement.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/cli/dispatch-agent-implement.ts#L21-L22), and [`dispatch-agent-orchestrator.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/cli/dispatch-agent-orchestrator.ts#L59-L63).

Implementation plan:

1. Add `"agent-daily-summary.yml": "disabled"` to the default schedule workflow overrides.
2. Change default orchestration max rounds from `5` to `12` across workflow inputs, vars fallbacks, and TypeScript fallback paths.
3. Update docs in [`configuration-list.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/customization/configuration-list.md#L11-L12) and scheduled workflow docs to reflect the new defaults.
4. Update tests that assert the old defaults, especially schedule-policy/scheduled-activity tests and orchestrator round-budget expectations.
5. Run the `.agent` test suite.

Reply with `/implement` and I can make the PR.
